title: MCompassRAG: Topic Metadata as a Semantic Compass for Paragraph-Level Retrieval
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems depend critically on how documents are chunked and searched. Fine-grained chunks can improve retrieval precision but expand the search space, increasing latency and cost; larger chunks reduce the number of candidates but make dense similarity less reliable, as the representation for each chunk mixes multiple topics and introduces more semantic noise. This trade-off becomes especially limiting in deep research tasks, where retrieval must be both fast and precise across large, heterogeneous corpora. We introduce MCompassRAG, a metadata-guided retrieval framework that uses topic-level signals as a semantic compass for selecting relevant evidence. Instead of relying only on cosine similarity between queries and noisy chunk embeddings, MCompassRAG enriches chunk representations with topic metadata in the same embedding space and trains a lightweight retriever through LLM-teacher distillation. At inference time, MCompassRAG performs topic-aware retrieval without additional LLM calls, improving both efficiency and evidence quality. Across six complex retrieval benchmarks, MCompassRAG improves information efficiency (IE) by 8.24% on average with over 5 times lower latency than the strongest efficient RAG baselines. Code is available on .

AI.tldr: MCompassRAG是一种元数据引导的检索框架，通过主题级信号和LLM蒸馏提升RAG系统的效率和准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统在文档分块与检索之间存在权衡：细粒度块提高精度但增加延迟和成本，大块降低语义可靠性。深度研究任务需要快速且精确的检索。
AI.method: 利用主题元数据丰富块嵌入，通过LLM教师蒸馏训练轻量级检索器，实现主题感知检索，无需额外LLM调用。
AI.result: 在六个复杂检索基准上，信息效率平均提升8.24%，延迟比最强基线降低5倍以上。
AI.conclusion: MCompassRAG通过主题感知检索有效平衡了精度与效率，适用于大规模异质语料库的深度研究任务。

fulltext_AI.summary: MCompassRAG是一种元数据引导的检索框架，通过将主题级元数据嵌入块表示并训练轻量级学生检索器，在保持粗粒度检索效率的同时显著提升检索精度。在六个基准上，其信息效率平均提升8.24%，延迟比最强高效RAG基线低5倍以上。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 提出MCompassRAG框架，利用主题元数据改善粗粒度检索而不增加搜索空间。2. 设计元数据选择与抽象机制，从语料库银行中筛选相关主题并生成紧凑查询主题向量。3. 通过LLM教师蒸馏训练学生检索器，实现推理时无LLM调用的高效主题感知证据选择。
fulltext_AI.method_details: MCompassRAG使用主题模型（如CEMTM）为每个块生成主题分布并缓存。推理时，查询经学生编码器编码后，通过选择策略从元数据银行中选取最相关的L个条目，经抽象模块细化得到查询主题分布。块表示由块嵌入与主要主题质心加权和拼接而成。学生MLP分类器对查询-块对评分。训练时，LLM教师基于扩展查询提供硬标签和软分数，学生通过BCE与KL散度联合损失学习，仅训练选择器、抽象模块和分类器。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 1. 依赖于主题模型质量，低资源领域可能性能下降。2. 引入多个超参数（如主题数K、选择条目数L、主题数M），调优复杂。3. 当前主题聚合为加权和，是损失性压缩，多主题时引入噪声，未来需探索稀疏或交叉注意力方法。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: MCompassRAG在粗粒度检索中有效利用主题元数据，显著提升精度且不增加推理延迟，改善了性能-效率权衡。其跨数据集泛化能力强，适用于深度研究等需要多次检索的场景，为高效RAG系统提供了新范式。

title: Lost in a Single Vector: Improving Long-Document Retrieval with Chunk Evidence Aggregation
comment: Code is available at this https URL
summary: Dense retrieval ranks one query vector against one document vector. On long documents, this interface can fail when a short but decisive span is weakened during document encoding before ranking. We study this failure mode as document-side early compression and introduce the Evidence Dilution Index (EDI) to measure how far a document-level representation falls below the strongest chunk-level evidence within the same gold document. Guided by this view, we propose DICE (Document Inference via Chunk Evidence), a training-free document-side strategy that splits documents into chunks, encodes them independently with a frozen model, and aggregates them back into a single vector while preserving the standard one-query-one-document interface. On LongEmbed, DICE improves retrieval across four backbones, with the largest gains on slices beyond 4k tokens: for Dream, Passkey >4k rises from 30.0 to 90.0 and Needle >4k from 23.3 to 74.0. Across 12,779 filtered samples, DICE yields lower EDI than the single-vector baseline in 92.8% of cases. These results establish document-level encoding as a practical and underexplored lever for long-document retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出DICE方法，通过分块编码和聚合改善长文档检索中的证据稀释问题。
AI.motivation: 长文档中关键片段在文档编码时被弱化，导致检索失败。
AI.method: DICE：将文档分割为块，独立编码后聚合为单个向量，保持查询-文档接口不变。
AI.result: 在LongEmbed上，检索性能提升，尤其超过4k tokens的片段；EDI在92.8%案例中低于基线。
AI.conclusion: 文档级编码是长文档检索中实用且未充分探索的杠杆。

fulltext_AI.summary: 论文研究了长文档密集检索中单向量编码导致局部关键证据被稀释的问题，提出证据稀释指数（EDI）以量化该现象，并提出DICE方法——将文档分块独立编码后通过均值池化等聚合为单向量，保持标准检索接口。在LongEmbed等基准上，DICE在多个骨干网络上显著提升了长文档检索性能，尤其超长上下文片段提升明显。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 识别并定义了文档端早期压缩失效模式，引入EDI指标进行量化。2. 提出DICE，一种免训练的文档端处理策略，无需改变检索接口。3. 实验证明DICE在四个骨干网络上均提升长文档检索，且与EDI降低一致。
fulltext_AI.method_details: DICE将文档分词后按固定块大小（默认1024）切分成非重叠块，每块独立编码（使用冻结编码器，位置索引从0开始），然后通过均值池化（默认）聚合所有块嵌入为单个文档向量。查询编码不变，检索使用余弦相似度。可选最大池化或top-k范数池化，但均值池化最鲁棒。该方法免训练，仅改变文档编码侧。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 1. 文档端编码成本增加约3-4倍。2. 聚合时不考虑查询，无法动态强调相关块。3. 仍压缩为单向量，相比多向量或段落检索丢失细粒度证据。这些限制了其在精度-效率前沿上的操作点。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 该工作揭示了文档端编码是长文档检索中尚未充分探索的改进方向，提供了一种简单有效的免训练方案，在不改变基础设施的情况下显著提升长文档检索效果，尤其适用于局部证据关键的场景。EDI指标也为诊断和优化证据稀释提供了量化工具。

title: CoreMem: Riemannian Retrieval and Fisher-Guided Distillation for Long-Term Memory in Dialogue Agents
summary: Personalized dialogue agents require continuous long-term memory to maintain coherent interactions across multiple sessions. However, deploying these capabilities on consumer-grade hardware (e.g., 8 GB VRAM edge devices) introduces severe memory and compute bottlenecks. Existing systems typically rely on isotropic cosine similarity for retrieval and heuristic rules for context compression. These approaches lack a unified theoretical foundation, frequently suffering from the hubness problem in high-dimensional retrieval and syntactic fragmentation during compression. To overcome these limitations, we propose CoreMem, a resource-efficient edge-cloud memory architecture fundamentally unified by information geometry. First, Riemannian retrieval replaces cosine matching with a locally adaptive Fisher-Rao metric, effectively penalizing hub memories via Mahalanobis distance with O(Ndr) Woodbury acceleration for real-time search. Second, Fisher-guided discrete token distillation (FDTD) introduces a hierarchical sentence-to-token compression mechanism. It derives sensitivity scores from Fisher information traces, providing a principled compression-KL tradeoff augmented with explicit structural syntax protection. Evaluated on the LOCOMO and LongMemEval-S benchmarks, CoreMem achieves strong accuracy improvements, yielding substantial gains in Open-domain (+4.51 pp) and Temporal (+4.17 pp) reasoning. Extensive profiling confirms that CoreMem operates seamlessly within a strict 8 GB VRAM budget, successfully bridging the gap between resource-constrained edge devices and the demand for theoretically grounded, lifelong memory agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoreMem，一种基于信息几何的资源高效边云记忆架构，通过黎曼检索和Fisher引导的离散令牌蒸馏，在8GB VRAM设备上实现长期记忆对话。
AI.motivation: 现有对话代理长期记忆方法在边缘设备上存在内存和计算瓶颈，且检索中余弦相似度导致hubness问题，压缩中启发式规则导致语法碎片化，缺乏统一理论基础。
AI.method: CoreMem架构包含两个核心组件：1) Riemannian retrieval，使用Fisher-Rao度量进行局部自适应检索，通过Mahalanobis距离和Woodbury加速实现实时搜索；2) Fisher-guided discrete token distillation (FDTD)，通过Fisher信息灵敏度分数进行层次化句子到令牌压缩，平衡压缩率和KL散度并保护语法结构。
AI.result: 在LOCOMO和LongMemEval-S基准上，CoreMem在开放域和时序推理上分别提升4.51和4.17个百分点，且在8GB VRAM预算内运行。
AI.conclusion: CoreMem成功弥合了资源受限边缘设备与理论化终生记忆代理之间的差距，提供了在消费级硬件上部署长期记忆对话代理的可能性。

fulltext_AI.summary: CoreMem提出了一种基于信息几何的长期记忆架构，用于资源受限的边缘对话代理。它通过黎曼检索（使用Fisher-Rao度量和Woodbury加速）缓解高维检索中的hubness问题，并通过费舍尔引导的离散令牌蒸馏（FDTD）提供有理论保证的上下文压缩。在LOCOMO和LongMemEval-S基准上，CoreMem在开放领域和时序推理上分别提升4.51和4.17个百分点，且在8 GB VRAM内高效运行。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 引入黎曼检索，以局部自适应Fisher-Rao度量替代余弦相似度，通过Woodbury加速实现实时搜索，缓解hubness问题。2. 提出费舍尔引导的离散令牌蒸馏（FDTD），利用费舍尔信息迹提供压缩-KL权衡，并集成结构语法保护。3. 在极端令牌预算和配置下进行综合压力测试和消融，揭示黎曼与余弦度量的互补优势。4. 在LOCOMO和LongMemEval-S上取得显著准确率提升，所有实验均在8 GB VRAM约束下完成。
fulltext_AI.method_details: CoreMem采用边缘-云混合架构。边缘设备使用轻量级编码器将查询和记忆嵌入，然后执行两步流水线：1) 黎曼检索：将嵌入建模为统计流形上的点，通过低秩SVD和Woodbury恒等式近似协方差矩阵，计算马氏距离，并与余弦相似度进行凸组合（融合权重α=0.5）。2) 费舍尔引导的离散令牌蒸馏（FDTD）：先计算每个令牌的对角费舍尔信息迹作为灵敏度得分，再通过分层句子级蒸馏（保护句子骨架）和结构掩码（语法、内容、衰减）优化，以令牌预算B为约束进行贪婪选择，最终将压缩上下文发送到云端LLM生成回答。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 1) 边缘部署约束：本地SLM（0.6B-1B参数）受VRAM限制，且当前使用平面记忆表示，无层次化组织。2) 泛化边界：实验限于英语基准，结构保护掩码在形态丰富语言上未验证；Woodbury加速在记忆超10万时开销增加。3) 评估范围：未进行全面因子全消融（如黎曼检索与FDTD交互），因API成本限制。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: CoreMem为边缘设备的长期记忆提供了首个统一的信息几何框架，同时解决了检索（hubness）和压缩（无理论保证）的核心问题。其设计使得在8 GB VRAM消费级硬件上即可运行，显著提升开放领域和时序推理能力，并通过本地压缩降低云端API成本，推动了实用化长期对话代理的发展。

title: SproutRAG: Attention-Guided Tree Search with Progressive Embeddings for Long-Document RAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems must balance retrieval granularity with contextual coherence, a challenge that existing methods address through LLM-guided chunking, single-level context expansion, or hierarchical summarization. These approaches variously depend on costly LLM calls during indexing or retrieval, limit context aggregation to a single granularity level, or introduce information loss through summarization. We present SproutRAG, an attention-guided hierarchical RAG framework that addresses this trade-off by organizing sentence-level chunks into progressively larger but semantically coherent units, using learned inter-sentence attention to construct a binary chunking tree. Unlike prior approaches that rely on external LLMs, fixed context expansion, or lossy summarization, SproutRAG learns which attention heads and layers best capture semantic document structure, enabling multi-granularity retrieval without additional LLM calls or compressed summaries. At retrieval time, SproutRAG uses hierarchical beam search to retrieve candidates at multiple granularities, capturing multi-sentence relevance beyond flat retrieval. The framework is trained end-to-end with a joint objective that improves both embeddings and tree structure. Experiments across four benchmarks spanning scientific, legal, and open-domain settings demonstrate that SproutRAG improves information efficiency (IE) by 6.1% on average over the strongest baseline. Code is available on .

AI.tldr: SproutRAG是一种注意力引导的分层RAG框架，通过构建二叉注意树实现多粒度检索而无需额外LLM调用。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法在平衡检索粒度与上下文连贯性时依赖LLM、固定上下文扩展或有损摘要，导致效率低或信息损失。
AI.method: SproutRAG利用学习到的句子间注意力构建二叉块树，将句子组织成层次化的语义单元，并在检索时使用分层波束搜索进行多粒度检索，模型端到端训练。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试中，SproutRAG的平均信息效率（IE）比最强基线提高6.1%。
AI.conclusion: SproutRAG通过注意力引导的分层架构有效解决了检索粒度与上下文连贯性的权衡问题，避免了额外LLM调用和信息损失。

fulltext_AI.summary: SproutRAG提出了一种注意力引导的层次化检索增强生成（RAG）框架，用于长文档。它使用小语言模型（SLLM）将文档分割为句子级块，并通过学习到的句子间注意力加权聚合构建二进制树，实现多粒度检索。联合训练目标同时优化嵌入质量和树结构，无需推理时的大语言模型（LLM）调用。在科学、法律和开放域四个基准上，平均信息效率提升6.1%，优于现有方法。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions:
1. 提出SproutRAG，一种注意力引导的层次化RAG框架，通过句子级块的二进制树实现多粒度检索，无需推理时LLM调用。
2. 识别并解决均匀注意力平均引入的邻近偏差，改用可学习的注意力头-层加权聚合来构建语义树。
3. 引入联合训练目标（检索对比损失+注意力结构损失），同时改善嵌入质量和树结构，消除对外部LLM过滤或损失性摘要的依赖。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 索引阶段：文档被分为句子级块，由SLLM编码得到句子嵌入和跨层跨头的注意力矩阵。学习每个头-层的标量权重，加权求和并对称化得到互相关分数。自底向上构建二叉树：每次合并互相关最高的两个节点，父节点嵌入为子节点平均，父节点与其余节点的互相关取子节点中的最大值。检索阶段：查询由相同SLLM编码，在树上执行层次波束搜索：从根开始，每步扩展当前波束中节点的子节点，保留余弦相似度最高的b个，收集所有相似度超过阈值δ的节点，经重排序后取top-k作为证据。训练目标：对比loss（式10）对齐查询与正例，注意力loss（式11）鼓励查询相关句子对获得高注意力。
fulltext_AI.limitations:
1. 树结构固定为二叉树，可能无法最优地捕捉多个句子同时形成的语义单元，多叉树或更灵活的结构可能更好。
2. 需要一次性的训练阶段（微调SLLM和注意力权重），虽然跨数据集泛化，但成本高于直接使用现成检索器。
3. 树索引是离线和固定的，无法根据查询进行动态重组，可能限制对查询特定信息组织的灵活性。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: SproutRAG有效平衡了RAG中检索粒度与上下文连贯性的矛盾，通过学习文档内在语义层次结构，无需额外LLM过滤或摘要即可同时检索精细句子和连贯段落，显著提升信息效率。其推理时低延迟和低token消耗（仅需4.38K tokens/查询）使其适用于实际长文档应用，同时为层次化RAG提供了基于注意力的可训练替代方案。

title: Beyond Reward Engineering: A Data Recipe for Long-Context Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-context reasoning is an essential capability for large language models, particularly when they are deployed as autonomous agents that must reason over lengthy trajectories. Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently emerged as a dominant paradigm for improving this ability, yet existing work largely focuses on reward engineering while diverse training data remains scarce. We revisit this problem from a data-centric perspective and show that a simple yet effective data recipe alone, paired with a minimal outcome-based GRPO setup, suffices to substantially improve long-context reasoning. Our recipe targets three complementary task families -- retrieval, multi-evidence synthesis, and reasoning -- for which we construct and curate eight datasets totaling ~14K examples. Experiments on three models (Qwen3-4B/8B/30B-A3B) yield average gains of +7.2/+3.2/+6.4 points across seven long-context benchmarks, surpassing prior RL training sets. We further demonstrate that these gains transfer to agentic tasks, where continuing RL training on an agent-tuned model with our data recipe improves GAIA by +4.8 and BrowseComp by +7.0 points. We will release our datasets to facilitate future research.

AI.tldr: 一个简单有效的数据配方结合最小化结果导向GRPO显著提升长上下文推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有RL方法多关注奖励工程，但训练数据稀缺，本文从数据为中心的角度改进长上下文推理。
AI.method: 构建包含检索、多证据合成和推理三个任务家族共8个数据集（约14K例子），采用最小化结果导向GRPO进行训练。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B/8B/30B-A3B模型上，七个长上下文基准平均提升+7.2/+3.2/+6.4分，超越先前RL训练集；在智能体任务中GAIA提升4.8分，BrowseComp提升7.0分。
AI.conclusion: 数据配方有效且可迁移至智能体任务，将公开数据集以促进未来研究。

fulltext_AI.summary: 本文提出一种数据为中心的配方用于长上下文强化学习，无需复杂的奖励工程。通过构建检索、多证据合成和推理三个互补任务类别的14K训练数据，在Qwen3-4B/8B/30B-A3B模型上平均提升+7.2/+3.2/+6.4分，超越先前数据集。进一步表明长上下文推理能力可迁移至智能体任务，提升GAIA和BrowseComp性能。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 证明数据配方而非奖励工程是长上下文RL有效性的关键。2. 提出三个互补任务类别（检索、多证据合成、推理）及其8个数据集的构建方法。3. 在多种模型上取得一致且大幅度的改进，并超越DocQA-RL和KeyChain基线。4. 展示长上下文RL训练可提升智能体任务表现。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 数据配方包含三类：检索（FuzzyNeedle、MultiNeedle）、多证据合成（CrossEntity、WebSearch、MultiQuery、KeyChain、LongDocQA）、推理（LongMath），共14,069个例子。RL使用GRPO，无KL正则，采用任务平衡采样和任务级优势归一化，奖励为词级召回率或LLM评判。训练参数：输入64K、生成16K、G=8、学习率1e-6，使用Adam优化器。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 1. 仅评估Qwen3系列模型（最大30B-A3B），未验证其他家族或更大模型。2. RL训练输入限制在64K tokens，未探索更长上下文。3. 大多数数据集为合成，可能不完全匹配真实分布。4. 智能体迁移研究初步，仅一个模型和两个基准。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 本文挑战了长上下文RL中奖励工程的流行方向，表明精心设计的数据多样性即可有效提升推理能力，且能迁移到智能体任务。开源数据集将促进社区研究，并为实际部署提供更简单的训练方案。

title: ScholarSum: Student-Teacher Abstractive Summarization via Knowledge Graph Reasoning and Reflective Refinement
summary: Abstractive summarization plays a crucial role in enabling efficient understanding of scientific literature, yet it inherently demands both linguistic fluency and factual faithfulness. Existing approaches often fail to reconcile these two requirements. Extractive methods rely on rigid sentence splicing that disrupts macro-level logical coherence, while large language model (LLM)-based generative approaches, despite mastering linguistic fluency, exhibit limited factual consistency. In this work, we propose ScholarSum, a hierarchical reflective graph-based framework that emulates a student-teacher writing process for fluent and faithful scientific summarization. ScholarSum first organizes the document into a hierarchical knowledge graph by segmenting it into semantically coherent units, whose multi-layered community structure captures global logic and macro-level themes. Guided by this global structure, the student generates an initial draft, which is subsequently refined through fine-grained evidence retrieval. To ensure factual consistency, a teacher-like reviewer then iteratively examines the draft, identifies unsupported content, and prompts targeted re-retrieval and rewriting until the summary meets rigorous quality standards. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ScholarSum significantly outperforms previous baselines in terms of both completeness and faithfulness. Our code is available at .

AI.tldr: A hierarchical reflective graph-based framework that emulates a student-teacher writing process achieves both fluency and faithfulness in scientific summarization.
AI.motivation: Existing abstractive summarization methods fail to simultaneously achieve linguistic fluency and factual faithfulness.
AI.method: ScholarSum constructs a hierarchical knowledge graph from the document, uses a 'student' to generate an initial draft, and a 'teacher' reviewer to iteratively examine and refine the summary via evidence retrieval and rewriting.
AI.result: ScholarSum significantly outperforms previous baselines in both completeness and faithfulness.
AI.conclusion: The proposed student-teacher framework effectively reconciles fluency and faithfulness in scientific summarization.

fulltext_AI.summary: 提出ScholarSum框架，通过模拟学生-教师写作过程，结合层次化知识图谱和迭代反思机制，实现既流畅又忠实于原文的学术摘要生成。在ArXiv和PubMed数据集上显著优于现有方法。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 提出层次化反思图框架，模拟学生-教师协作写作过程；2. 利用知识图谱捕获文档全局逻辑，指导结构化的初稿生成；3. 设计教师式的迭代精炼模块，通过检索相似论文提供反馈，逐步修正事实不一致内容。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 首先，将文档分割为语义单元，抽取实体和关系构建层次化知识图谱，并通过社区检测识别主题。学生基于图谱的社区结构生成子摘要，并选择关键三元组作为事实锚点，合成初稿。教师模块检索领域相似论文，评估初稿质量，输出分数和结构化反馈；根据分数执行接受、微小修订或重大修订（要求重新生成）。迭代至质量阈值或最大轮次。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 依赖LLM的生成能力，可能继承其局部幻觉；检索和迭代过程增加计算开销；知识图谱构建质量依赖实体关系抽取的准确性；评估指标以自动为主，缺乏人类判断验证。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 有效解决了抽象摘要中语言流畅性与事实忠实性之间的矛盾，通过结构化规划与迭代验证提供了一种系统性的平衡方案，对科学文献理解与知识传播具有重要价值。

title: Human-AI Coevolution Dynamics: A Formal Theory of Social Intelligence Emergence Through Long-Term Interaction
summary: Current conversational AI systems have made significant progress in language generation, personalization, and long-context interaction. However, most existing methods model social behavior through isolated components such as emotion modeling, memory retrieval, or persona conditioning, lacking a unified framework to explain the emergence of stable social relationships and social intelligence in long-term human-AI address this, we propose the Human-AI Coevolution Dynamics Framework (HACD-H), a formal model of human-AI interaction as a self-organizing social cognitive system. HACD-H integrates emotional adaptation, relational organization, social memory, and personality consistency into a unified dynamical framework and introduces principles including multi-timescale social cognition, relational attractors, trust basins, developmental phase transitions, and social cognitive energy construct a conversational dataset with approximately 14,700 interaction turns and develop a theory-driven empirical evaluation framework. Results reveal a hierarchy of temporal persistence in social cognition, stable relational attractors, phase-transition-like developmental patterns, and a structured social cognitive energy landscape. Social intelligence shows a significant negative correlation with social cognitive energy (r = -0.391, p < 0.001), and interaction trajectories exhibit progressive energy reduction over findings suggest that social intelligence emerges from long-term social cognitive coevolution rather than isolated conversational capabilities. HACD-H provides a unified theoretical foundation for modeling adaptive human-AI social interaction and developing socially intelligent AI systems.

AI.tldr: 提出人类-AI协同进化动力学框架(HACD-H)，用于建模长期人机交互中社会智能的出现。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过孤立组件建模社会行为，缺乏统一框架解释稳定社会关系和社会智能的出现。
AI.method: 构建HACD-H框架，整合情感适应、关系组织、社会记忆和人格一致性，引入多时间尺度社会认知等原则，并构建约14,700交互轮次的对话数据集进行理论驱动评估。
AI.result: 揭示社会认知的时间持久性层次、稳定关系吸引子、发展相变模式及结构化能量景观；社会智能与社会认知能量负相关(r=-0.391, p<0.001)，交互轨迹能量递减。
AI.conclusion: 社会智能源于长期社会认知协同进化，HACD-H为建模适应性人机社会交互提供统一理论基础。

title: Morpheus: A Morphology-Aware Neural Tokenizer and Word Embedder for Turkish
summary: Turkish is agglutinative: meaning is carried by morphemes, yet the subword tokenizers that drive modern language models split words by corpus statistics, fragmenting semantically loaded suffixes and -- in the case of WordPiece and rule-based analyzers -- failing to decode their output back to the original text. This paper presents \textbf{Morpheus}, a neural morpheme-boundary model for Turkish that is at once a lossless, morphology-aware tokenizer and a word-embedding producer. A differentiable Poisson-binomial dynamic program turns per-character boundary probabilities into soft morpheme memberships during training and exact segments at inference, with no string normalization, so $\mathrm{decode}(\mathrm{encode}(w)) = w$ holds by construction. Because the model is neural, the same forward pass that tokenizes also emits a structured word embedding. Among reversible tokenizers -- the only ones valid for generation -- Morpheus attains the lowest bits-per-character ($1.425$), roughly doubles the gold morphological alignment of the subword family (MorphScore macro-F1 $0.61$ vs.\ ${\sim}0.32$), and uses ${\sim}19\%$ less GPU memory than 64K-vocabulary subword tokenizers. As an embedder, frozen Morpheus vectors lead on lexical retrieval (root-family MAP $0.85$) and same-root verification (ROC-AUC $1.00$), surpassing the multilingual retriever BGE-M3 and BERTurk; on context- and inflection-dependent tasks (NER, case/number probing) the heavier contextual encoders remain ahead -- a trade-off we attribute to Morpheus's root-centric geometry. Code: model: interactive demo: .

AI.tldr: Morpheus is a neural morpheme-boundary model for Turkish that serves as a lossless, morphology-aware tokenizer and word-embedding producer, achieving strong performance on reversible tokenization and lexical retrieval tasks.
AI.motivation: Turkish is agglutinative, with meaning carried by morphemes, but subword tokenizers split words by corpus statistics, fragmenting semantically loaded suffixes and sometimes failing to decode back to original text.
AI.method: A differentiable Poisson-binomial dynamic program converts per-character boundary probabilities into soft morpheme memberships during training and exact segments at inference, with no string normalization, ensuring decode(encode(w)) = w. The same forward pass also produces a structured word embedding.
AI.result: Among reversible tokenizers, Morpheus achieves the lowest bits-per-character (1.425), roughly doubles morphological alignment (MorphScore macro-F1 0.61 vs. ~0.32), and uses ~19% less GPU memory than 64K-vocabulary subword tokenizers. As an embedder, it leads on lexical retrieval (root-family MAP 0.85) and same-root verification (ROC-AUC 1.00), surpassing BGE-M3 and BERTurk, but lags on context-dependent tasks (NER, case/number probing).
AI.conclusion: Morpheus offers a strong trade-off for morphology-intensive tasks with its root-centric geometry, achieving high performance on lexical and morphologically aligned tasks while using less memory, though heavier contextual encoders remain superior for context-dependent tasks.

fulltext_AI.summary: Morpheus是一个针对土耳其语的神经词素边界模型，同时作为无损、形态感知的分词器和词嵌入生成器。它使用可微泊松-二项动态规划统一训练和推理，无需字符串归一化，保证完全可逆。在可逆分词器中，Morpheus达到最低的bits-per-character (1.425)，形态对齐分数（MorphScore macro-F1 0.61）约为子词家族的两倍，GPU内存节省约19%。作为嵌入器，它在词汇检索和同根验证上领先，但在上下文依赖任务上不如上下文编码器。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 提出Morpheus，一个神经形态感知分词器，通过可微泊松-二项软分割实现无损、可逆的分词。2. 证明同一模型可同时作为词嵌入生成器，在根族检索、词汇去重等任务上超越现有模型。3. 提供全面的评估套件，包括可逆性、形态对齐、表面保真度、语言建模BPC等，明确区分无损与有损分词器。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 模型将单词作为字符序列处理，通过多尺度卷积和自注意力加上RoPE编码字符。边界检测器输出每个字符间位置的边界概率。利用可微泊松-二项动态规划计算软段成员矩阵（训练）或硬段（推理）。段向量通过注意力池化得到，单词嵌入为段向量的均值经过FFN。训练损失包含辅助边界损失（监督来自Morfessor）、skip-gram负采样、根身份对比损失和字符级MLM损失。训练数据为约10GB的多注册土耳其语语料库，采用AdamW优化器，余弦学习率，批量512，训练10个epoch。
fulltext_AI.limitations: Morpheus的局限包括：更高的生育率（每词约1.73个token vs 子词约1.5）导致生成吞吐量降低约1.6倍；神经模型需要PyTorch检查点而非轻量词汇表；以根为中心的嵌入在上下文依赖任务（如NER、格/数探测）上表现不如上下文编码器；模型为土耳其语设计，且评估偏向词形变化而非派生形态。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: Morpheus填补了土耳其语等黏着语中缺乏同时满足无损、形态感知、高效和嵌入功能的单一模型的空白。它可逆的分词确保了生成文本的忠实性，形态对齐提高了下游性能，而词嵌入功能无需额外模型。对于土耳其语的NLU、检索、小模型预训练和内存受限推理，Morpheus提供了一个更好的默认选择，并明确了无损与有损分词器的关键区别。

title: Which Sections of a Research Paper Best Reveal Its Research Methods? Evidence from Library and Information Science
summary: Research methods are essential carriers of knowledge contribution in academic papers. Automatic multi-label classification of research methods can support knowledge services such as method retrieval, review generation, and research intelligence analysis. While existing studies primarily rely on titles and abstracts, abstracts often provide only limited methodological information, whereas utilizing full-text content faces challenges related to excessive length and information redundancy. Therefore, this paper proposes a segment combination strategy by partitioning the full-text content according to its physical postion. Using an annotated corpus of 1,954 full-text articles from three representative journals in Library and Information Science (JASIST, LISR, and JDoc), we evaluate the classification performance of various segments and their combinations across multiple models. Experimental results indicate that methodological information is distributed unevenly within the full-text content, with the middle-to-late and final segments exhibiting greater discriminative power. Furthermore, integrating bibliographic metadata with cross-segment combination strategies effectively enhances classification performance.

AI.tldr: 提出基于全文分段组合策略的研究方法自动分类方法，有效提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究依赖标题摘要但信息有限，全文过长且冗余，需更好利用全文内容。
AI.method: 将全文按物理位置分段，构建标注语料库，评估不同分段及组合的分类性能。
AI.result: 方法信息分布不均匀，中后段和末尾段区分力更强；书目元数据与跨段组合可提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 分段组合策略有效，方法信息分布在全文不同部分，联合元数据可增强分类。

title: Hierarchical Multi-Modal Retrieval for Knowledge-Grounded News Image Captioning
summary: Traditional image captioning methods often struggle to generate comprehensive, context-rich descriptions, especially for details not directly observable from visual cues. To overcome this, we propose a novel retrieval-augmented image captioning framework that generates captions with deeper insights, such as object attributes, event context, and underlying significance, by leveraging external knowledge. Our approach features a hierarchical multi-modal article retrieval mechanism that moves beyond monolithic text entities. This retrieval considers article structure-aware features, including weighted textual components (e.g., headlines, body sections) and visual placement patterns, alongside multi-faceted similarity computations (content--visual, visual--visual, and discourse positioning). A subsequent contextual relevance refinement stage further enhances the retrieved information. The retrieved articles then serve as the knowledge base for caption generation: first, a VLM generates a concise image description; second, we segment relevant information from the retrieved articles based on this description; and finally, an LLM utilizes both the description and extracted knowledge to generate a comprehensive, contextually detailed caption. We participated in the ACM Multimedia EVENTA 2025 Challenge and achieved 5th place with an overall score of 0.2824 on the private test set of the OpenEvent-V1 dataset. Source code is publicly released at .

AI.tldr: 提出检索增强图像字幕框架，利用层级多模态文章检索与LLM生成上下文丰富描述，在EVENTA挑战赛获第五。
AI.motivation: 传统方法依赖视觉线索，难以生成包含对象属性、事件上下文等深层信息的全面描述。
AI.method: 采用层级多模态文章检索，考虑文章结构特征（标题、正文权重）与视觉布局，结合内容-视觉、视觉-视觉及话语位置相似度；然后VLM生成初始描述，基于描述分割文章相关信息，LLM合并生成最终字幕。
AI.result: 在OpenEvent-V1私有测试集上得分为0.2824，排名ACM Multimedia EVENTA 2025第五名。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效利用外部知识增强图像字幕的上下文丰富性，但性能仍有提升空间。

fulltext_AI.summary: 本文提出了一种层次化多模态检索增强的图像描述框架，用于新闻图像的知识引导描述。该框架通过结构感知的文章分解和多方面相似度计算（内容-视觉、视觉-视觉、语篇位置）检索相关文章，随后利用三阶段流水线（VLM视觉理解、相关句子提取、LLM知识融合）生成兼具视觉忠实性和事实准确性的描述。在EVENTA 2025挑战赛中获得第5名。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 提出层次化多模态文章检索机制，将文章分解为加权组件（标题、导语、正文、图注）。2. 设计多方面相似度计算（内容-视觉对齐、视觉-视觉连贯性、语篇定位分数）。3. 提出三阶段LLM驱动的描述生成流水线：结构化视觉上下文提取、相关上下文提取、知识融合生成。4. 在ACM Multimedia EVENTA 2025挑战赛中获得第5名。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 检索模块：将文章分解为标题、导语、正文、图注，并分配学习权重；视觉特征通过位置调制与文章图像嵌入融合；相似度计算包括内容-视觉（查询视觉嵌入与文章文本嵌入的余弦相似度）、视觉-视觉（与文章图像嵌入的最大余弦相似度）、语篇定位（按图像位置加权的余弦相似度）；经时间聚类和引用PageRank优化。描述生成：第一阶段使用VLM生成结构化视觉描述（客观描述、语境推断、情绪氛围、潜在标题）；第二阶段将视觉描述通过M3-embedding编码，从排名第一的检索文章中选取最相似的3个句子并扩展邻近句子；第三阶段LLM融合视觉描述和提取的文章上下文生成最终描述。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 1. 检索性能（mAP 0.708）落后于顶尖方法，可能因微调或数据增强不足。2. CIDEr得分低（0.081），说明生成描述在词汇层面与参考描述匹配困难，尽管语义相关性（CLIP Score 0.783）较好。3. 依赖单一排名最高的文章，多篇文章引入噪声。4. 仅在OpenEvent-V1数据集上验证，泛化性待检验。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 该工作针对新闻图像描述中需要深入语境信息（如人物、地点、事件意义）的需求，提供了一种有效的检索增强框架。层次化文章检索和方面相似度计算提升了相关性，三阶段流水线在视觉保真和事实准确性间取得平衡。对自动新闻生成、无障碍访问等应用具有重要价值。

title: LARE: Low-Attention Region Encoding for Text-Image Retrieval
comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Efficient Multimodal Question Answering (EMM-QA). Code: this https URL ; Dataset: this https URL
summary: Image retrieval in crowded scenes is particularly challenging due to the salience bias of conventional visual encoders, which tend to focus on dominant objects while neglecting low-attention regions that are often crucial for fine-grained retrieval. We propose LARE (Low-Attention Region Encoding), a framework that explicitly models these overlooked regions. LARE adopts a dual-encoding strategy that encodes low-attention regions of an image and the full image in parallel, leading to more diverse and informative image embeddings. To evaluate image retrieval performance in challenging crowded scenes, we introduce Dense-Set, a challenging subset derived from COCO and Flickr30K. In this subset, images are re-captioned to provide richer descriptions of low-attention or previously overlooked regions. This dataset highlights the limitations of existing retrieval models and enables a more rigorous evaluation under densely crowded scene conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework improves retrieval performance by preserving subtle, non-dominant visual cues within the shared latent space.

AI.tldr: 提出LARE框架，通过双编码低注意力区域和完整图像，改善拥挤场景中的图像检索。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉编码器在拥挤场景中存在显著性偏差，忽略低注意力区域，影响细粒度检索。
AI.method: 提出LARE框架，采用双编码策略并行编码低注意力区域和完整图像，生成更多样和信息丰富的嵌入；同时引入Dense-Set数据集，重新标注以描述低注意力区域。
AI.result: 实验表明LARE通过保存微妙的非主导视觉线索，提高了检索性能。
AI.conclusion: LARE有效改善了拥挤场景中的图像检索，并提供了新的评估基准。

title: DREAM: Extending Vision-Language Models with Dual-Objective Encoding for Cross-Modal Retrieval
summary: In today's media-driven world, the exponential growth of video content across domains such as surveillance, education, and entertainment has made retrieving semantically relevant videos via natural language queries increasingly critical. Early video retrieval systems relied on handcrafted features or shallow cross-modal mappings, limiting their ability to capture complex semantics and temporal dynamics. While large-scale vision-language models have improved cross-modal alignment, challenges remain in modeling fine-grained temporal dependencies and nuanced linguistic structures. In this paper, we introduce DREAM: Dual-path Representation Enhancement and Alignment Model, a novel multimodal framework that addresses these limitations through enhanced visual and textual encoding. DREAM incorporates a hybrid language modeling strategy that combines masked and permuted language modeling objectives to capture both local and global linguistic semantics. On the visual side, we design a hierarchical vision encoder with cascaded group attention, which integrates spatial and temporal information through multi-stage token interaction and coarse-to-fine attention refinement. We validate DREAM through comprehensive evaluations on the widely-used MSRVTT, MSVD and LSMDC benchmark datasets, where it achieves new state-of-the-art R1 scores of 49.4%, 49.7% and 27.3%, respectively. Qualitative analyses further show the model's ability to maintain coherent attention across frames and align complex queries with dynamic video content. These findings underscore the effectiveness of hierarchical attention and dual-objective textual modeling in enabling robust, context-aware video retrieval, and pave the way for future research in advancing cross-modal representation learning.

AI.tldr: 提出了DREAM模型，通过混合语言建模和层次视觉编码器提升视频检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频检索系统难以捕捉复杂语义和时间动态，需要更好的跨模态对齐。
AI.method: DREAM采用混合语言建模（masked和permuted）和层次视觉编码器（级联组注意力），实现双路径表示增强和对齐。
AI.result: 在MSRVTT、MSVD和LSMDC上分别取得49.4%、49.7%和27.3%的R1得分，达到新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 层次注意力和双目标文本建模有效促进鲁棒、上下文感知的视频检索，为跨模态表示学习提供方向。

title: WorldLines: Benchmarking and Modeling Long-Horizon Stateful Embodied Agents
summary: To assist humans over extended periods in real homes, embodied agents must remember user routines, world states, and past interactions. Existing long-term memory benchmarks mainly evaluate language-centric retrieval and question answering, while embodied benchmarks often focus on short-horizon task execution without testing long-term memory use in dynamic environments. We introduce WorldLines, a project-driven benchmark for long-horizon embodied household assistance. It constructs temporally extended household traces with dialogues, actions, execution feedback, object and device state changes, and converts them into evidence-linked samples for Memory QA and Embodied Task Planning. We further propose ObsMem, an observer-grounded memory framework that maintains visibility-aware memories and action-native state trails for state-aware decisions. Experiments reveal persistent challenges in partial observability, overwritten world states, and translating long-term memory into embodied plans, while ObsMem offers a stronger reference architecture for this setting.

AI.tldr: 提出了WorldLines基准和ObsMem框架，用于评估长期具身家庭助手在动态环境中的记忆和规划能力。
AI.motivation: 现有长期记忆基准主要评估语言检索和问答，具身基准则聚焦短时间任务，缺乏对动态环境中长期记忆使用的测试。
AI.method: 构建WorldLines，包含长时间家庭轨迹（对话、动作、反馈等），转换为Memory QA和Embodied Task Planning样本；提出ObsMem框架，维护可见性感知记忆和动作原生状态轨迹。
AI.result: 实验揭示了部分可观察性、世界状态覆盖等挑战，ObsMem提供了更强的参考架构。
AI.conclusion: ObsMem是更优的架构，但仍需解决长期记忆用于具身规划中的难题。

title: Show, Don't Ask: Generative Visual Disambiguation for Composed Image Retrieval with Turn-Valid Coverage
summary: Composed image retrieval (CIR) uses a reference image and a text modification to search for a target image. However, such queries often describe several possible images rather than one exact target, making the user's intent ambiguous. Recent methods address this by using conformal prediction to estimate ambiguity and by asking users clarifying text questions. However, these methods have two limitations: their coverage guarantee only holds at the first interaction, and text questions are often insufficient for resolving fine-grained visual differences such as appearance, attributes, or viewpoint. We propose CLARA, a clarification framework that resolves ambiguity by showing users a small panel of visual alternatives. Instead of answering text questions, the user simply selects the prototype image closest to the intended target. This provides a direct visual signal and avoids relying on a model to predict the user's answer. To maintain valid conformal guarantees across multiple interaction rounds, CLARA reweights calibration using the likelihood ratio induced by the user's selection. The displayed prototypes are also constrained to represent the current candidate set and are snapped to real corpus images, ensuring that generated images cannot artificially improve coverage. Experiments on open-domain and fashion benchmarks show that CLARA matches single-turn state-of-the-art retrieval performance, maintains nominal coverage across interaction rounds, and finds the intended target in fewer rounds than strong text-question baselines. Its advantage is especially clear when ambiguity involves viewpoint or fine-grained attributes, where visual clarification is more effective than textual questioning.

AI.tldr: 提出CLARA框架，通过视觉替代面板和重新加权校准来解决组合图像检索中的歧义，并在多轮交互中保持覆盖保证。
AI.motivation: 现有方法使用文本澄清问题，但覆盖保证仅在第一轮有效，且文本问题不足以解决细粒度视觉差异。
AI.method: CLARA通过展示视觉替代面板让用户选择最接近目标的原型图像，利用似然比重新加权校准以维持多轮覆盖保证，并约束原型表示当前候选集且从真实语料库中选取。
AI.result: 在开放域和时尚基准测试中，CLARA匹配了单轮最新检索性能，在多轮交互中保持名义覆盖，并以更少轮数找到目标，特别是在涉及视角或细粒度属性的歧义时表现出色。
AI.conclusion: CLARA通过视觉澄清有效解决了用户意图歧义，并在多轮交互中提供了有效的覆盖保证。

title: CaVe-VLM-CoT: An Interpretable Vision-Language Model Framework
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remain prone to hallucinations, producing fluent but visually unfaithful outputs. Existing chain-of-thought and retrieval-augmented methods only partially address this, as they neither enforce step-level citation grounding nor route verification failures back to retrieval for correction. We present CaVe-VLM-CoT, a modular reflection-based agentic-RAG framework that enforces evidence-grounded reasoning through a five-stage closed-loop pipeline: Extractor, Retriever, Solver, Citation Injector, and Verifier, in which detected ungrounded claims trigger structured feedback to the Extractor for targeted re-retrieval. Since no existing framework jointly measures retrieval quality, step-wise citation faithfulness, and cross-modal grounding, we propose a suite of 23 component-wise metrics across all stages, anchored by CaVeScore, a composite metric weighting accuracy, citation precision and recall, attribution, and evidence grounding. Without any architectural or prompt modifications, CaVe-VLM-CoT achieves 87.1\% accuracy and 56.6\% CaVeScore on ScienceQA , and 55.2\% accuracy and 35.7\% CaVeScore on MMMU (30 subjects).

AI.tldr: 提出CaVe-VLM-CoT，一个基于反思的agentic-RAG框架，通过五阶段闭环管道强制执行基于证据的推理，并引入CaVeScore指标，在ScienceQA和MMMU上取得改进。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型容易产生幻觉，现有方法没有强制步骤级引用或路由验证失败回退到检索。
AI.method: 五阶段闭环管道：Extractor、Retriever、Solver、Citation Injector、Verifier，未接地声明触发结构化反馈以进行针对性重新检索，并引入23个组件级指标（含CaVeScore）。
AI.result: ScienceQA上准确率87.1%，CaVeScore 56.6%；MMMU上准确率55.2%，CaVeScore 35.7%。
AI.conclusion: 无需架构或提示修改即可显著提升性能，表明证据接地和反馈循环的有效性。

title: Decoupling Search from Reasoning: A Vendor-Agnostic Grounding Architecture for LLM Agents
summary: Production LLM agents increasingly depend on real-time search, yet native search grounding bundles retrieval policy, provider choice, evidence injection, cost, latency, and generation behavior behind a single model-provider boundary. This coupling makes grounding hard to inspect, tune, reuse, or port, and can trigger Search-Induced Verbosity that breaks strict output contracts. We present Decoupled Search Grounding (DSG), a vendor-agnostic boundary that moves grounding outside the reasoning model through an MCP-compatible gateway, exposing provider routing, source-aware context rendering, configured fallback, retrieval-depth control, and exact plus semantic caching as first-class controls. Across five frontier models on SimpleQA, FreshQA, and HotpotQA, native search leads on recency-sensitive FreshQA, but DSG exposes a stronger frontier when control matters: on SimpleQA it nearly matches native accuracy (86.1% vs. 87.7%) at 91% lower search cost, preserves concise answer contracts, and reaches a 99.4% warm-cache hit rate with 68% lower latency. Deployed as a shared production grounding layer for large-scale agentic workloads with interchangeable models, DSG matches or slightly exceeds native-search accuracy on an e-commerce query-understanding (QIU) workload while cutting search cost by over 98%. Real-time grounding is best treated as an optimizable interface boundary, not a fixed model feature.

AI.tldr: DSG将搜索接地从推理模型中解耦，通过MCP兼容网关提供可配置控制，在保持准确性的同时大幅降低成本和延迟。
AI.motivation: 原生搜索接地将检索策略、提供商选择、证据注入、成本、延迟和生成行为捆绑在一起，难以检查、调优、复用或移植，并可能引发搜索诱导的冗长问题。
AI.method: 提出Decoupled Search Grounding (DSG)，一个与供应商无关的边界，通过MCP兼容网关将接地移出推理模型，暴露提供商路由、源感知上下文渲染、配置回退、检索深度控制以及精确和语义缓存作为一等控制。
AI.result: 在SimpleQA上DSG准确率86.1% vs 原生87.7%，但搜索成本降低91%，延迟降低68%，缓存命中率99.4%；在e-commerce QIU任务上搜索成本降低超98%，准确性匹配或略超原生。
AI.conclusion: 实时接地应被视为可优化的接口边界，而不是固定的模型特征。

title: User as Engram: Internalizing Per-User Memory as Local Parametric Edits
summary: Personal memory in a language model is two problems: content and reasoning skill. The brain keeps the two apart (a sparse, local engram in the hippocampus for each episode, a slow neocortex for the shared skills that interpret it), so a new fact need not overwrite everything else. Most personalization today keeps a user's facts outside the weights, in a natural-language memory file or a retrieval index. When facts are written into the model instead, the standard recipe is the per-user LoRA adapter, which does the opposite of the brain, folding content and skill into one global weight delta. Writing a user's facts as a LoRA contaminates text unrelated to them; writing the same facts as local Engram rows leaves it mathematically untouched, resulting in a roughly 33,000x smaller memory footprint. We therefore propose User as Engram: store a user's content as surgical edits to the hash-keyed memory table of an Engram model, and carry the reasoning skill in one shared adapter. This layered design matches per-user LoRA's direct recall while delivering 5.6x higher indirect-reasoning accuracy on average, and never makes a single user worse at reasoning than the untouched base. The edit is a glass box: writing a fact switches on its lookup at exactly the trigger, adds the value the answer needs, leaves every other position unchanged to the last bit, and fails if written into the wrong layer. Because different users' facts land in disjoint hash slots, their edits compose: many users live in one shared table at once, stacking additively and losslessly, where a per-user LoRA, a single global weight delta, admits only one. Upon retrieval, a per-user Engram table does not grow with the population the retriever must search, so past ~100 facts it overtakes a retrieval pipeline on a 2.5x larger model.

AI.tldr: User as Engram通过将用户内容存储为对Engram模型哈希键控记忆表的精确编辑，推理技能放在共享适配器中，实现了与大脑相似的内容-技能分离，比每用户LoRA在间接推理准确率上平均提高5.6倍，内存占用小33,000倍，且不降低推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有每用户LoRA将内容和技能混合在一个全局权重增量中，污染无关文本，而大脑将内容（海马体）和技能（新皮层）分离。需要一种个性化方法，既能直接回忆事实，又不会干扰其他文本或推理技能。
AI.method: 使用Engram模型，将用户内容作为精确编辑写入哈希键控记忆表，每个事实在触发时激活查找并添加答案值；推理技能则通过一个共享的LoRA适配器编码。编辑是‘玻璃盒’：精确触发、仅改变目标位置，且在不同层失败时停止。不同用户的事实落在不同哈希槽，可无损叠加。
AI.result: 相比每用户LoRA，间接推理准确率平均提升5.6倍，内存占用降低约33,000倍，且从未使单个用户的推理能力低于未修改的基础模型。当事实数超过约100个时，性能超越使用2.5倍规模模型的检索流水线。
AI.conclusion: User as Engram是一种高效、可扩展的个性化方法，通过分离内容与技能，避免了LoRA的污染问题，同时保持了直接回忆能力，并大幅提升了间接推理和内存效率。

title: JetFlow: Breaking the Scaling Ceiling of Speculative Decoding with Parallel Tree Drafting
summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) by drafting multiple tokens and verifying them in parallel, but it faces a scaling limitation: increasing the draft budget improves speed only when acceptance remains high and drafting overhead stays low. This ceiling has been difficult to break because prior head-based SD methods face a causality-efficiency dilemma. Autoregressive drafters produce path-conditioned candidates that are effective for tree speculative decoding with higher acceptance length, but their drafting cost grows with tree depth. Bidirectional block-diffusion drafters generate all positions in one pass, but their branch-agnostic marginals can form individually plausible yet mutually inconsistent trees, wasting budget and reducing acceptance. We propose JetFlow, a head-based SD framework that combines one-forward drafting efficiency with branch-wise causal conditioning. JetFlow trains a causal parallel draft head over fused hidden states from the frozen target model, producing candidate trees whose scores align with the target model's autoregressive factorization. This enables JetFlow to convert larger draft budgets into longer accepted prefixes and higher end-to-end speedup. Across math, coding, and chat benchmarks on dense and MoE Qwen3 models, JetFlow consistently outperforms bidirectional-head and tree-based SD baselines. On H100 GPUs, JetFlow achieves up to 9.64x speedup on MATH-500 and 4.58x on open-ended conversational workloads, with further latency gains demonstrated through vLLM integration under realistic serving loads. Our code and models are available at .

AI.tldr: JetFlow is a head-based speculative decoding framework that combines one-forward drafting efficiency with branch-wise causal conditioning, achieving up to 9.64x speedup on MATH-500 and consistently outperforming baselines.
AI.motivation: Prior head-based speculative decoding methods face a causality-efficiency dilemma: autoregressive drafters are effective but costly, while bidirectional drafters produce inconsistent trees, limiting the scaling of draft budget into speedup.
AI.method: JetFlow trains a causal parallel draft head over fused hidden states from the frozen target model, generating candidate trees aligned with the target model's autoregressive factorization, enabling efficient one-forward drafting with branch-wise causality.
AI.result: On dense and MoE Qwen3 models across math, coding, and chat benchmarks, JetFlow achieves up to 9.64x speedup on MATH-500 and 4.58x on open-ended conversational workloads on H100 GPUs, consistently outperforming bidirectional-head and tree-based SD baselines.
AI.conclusion: JetFlow effectively breaks the scaling limitation of speculative decoding by converting larger draft budgets into longer accepted prefixes and higher end-to-end speedup, demonstrating significant latency gains in realistic serving.

title: VISUALSKILL: Multimodal Skills for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) approach human-level performance on standardised benchmarks but still struggle on long-horizon tasks and unseen software. Existing skill libraries address this with reusable skills, but represent the skill artifact as text only, despite the visual nature of GUI interaction. We propose VISUALSKILL: a hierarchical multimodal skill, tailored to each target application and organised as a central index over per-topic files, which the agent consumes through a load_topic MCP tool that fetches the relevant topic's text and figures on demand. We construct each skill with a two-stage pipeline that combines authored documentation with live-application UI exploration. On two CUA benchmarks, CUA-World and OSExpert-Eval, a Claude Code CLI agent backed by Claude Opus 4.6 reaches an average score of 0.456 with VISUALSKILL, a +15.3 point absolute lift over the no-skill baseline (0.303). Against a matched text-only skill that is generated from the same source content and differs from VISUALSKILL only in modality, VISUALSKILL yields a further +8.3 point absolute gain over the matched text-only skill (0.373 vs. 0.456), providing direct evidence that retaining visual figures in the skill artifact, rather than verbalizing them away, helps the agent both identify UI elements and verify workflow state after each action. Our code is available at .

AI.tldr: VISUALSKILL is a hierarchical multimodal skill for computer-use agents that uses a central index over per-topic files with text and figures, constructed via authored documentation and live UI exploration, achieving a +15.3 point absolute gain over no-skill baseline and +8.3 over text-only skill on CUA benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Existing skill libraries represent skills as text only, ignoring the visual nature of GUI interaction, which limits performance on long-horizon tasks and unseen software.
AI.method: A two-stage pipeline that combines authored documentation with live-application UI exploration to construct hierarchical multimodal skills, organized as a central index over per-topic files, consumed by the agent via a load_topic MCP tool to fetch relevant text and figures on demand.
AI.result: On CUA-World and OSExpert-Eval, a Claude Code CLI agent with Claude Opus 4.6 using VISUALSKILL achieves an average score of 0.456, compared to 0.303 (no-skill) and 0.373 (matched text-only skill), representing +15.3 and +8.3 point absolute gains respectively.
AI.conclusion: Retaining visual figures in the skill artifact, rather than verbalizing them away, helps the agent identify UI elements and verify workflow state after each action, providing direct evidence that multimodal representation outperforms text-only representation for GUI agents.

title: Steerable Cultural Preference Optimization of Reward Models
summary: It is essential for large language model (LLM) technology to serve many different cultural sub-communities in a manner that is acceptable to each community. However, research on LLM alignment has so far predominantly focused on predicting a unified response preference of annotators from certain regions. This paper aims to advance the development of alignment models with a more global outlook, that are able to accurately represent the preferences of subcommunities and do not exhibit excessive bias towards any of them. We focus on the development of reward models for this purpose and present a novel reward model training algorithm (SCPO) that can incorporate diverse cultural preferences in a balanced manner. Our method results in performance increases of the minority reward model of up to 7 points over the baseline model across two datasets, PRISM and GlobalOpinionQA, and across 7 countries. SCPO is up to 280% more training data-efficient than full-data finetuning of reward models. In addition, we perform analysis of bias by separately evaluating on the preference of subcommunities and show that excessive bias is mitigated via our weighting method. Our code is available at

AI.tldr: 提出SCPO算法，通过加权训练平衡多元文化偏好，提升奖励模型性能和数据效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM对齐研究主要关注统一偏好，缺乏对多元文化子社区的准确表达。
AI.method: 提出SCPO算法，在奖励模型训练中通过加权方法平衡不同文化偏好。
AI.result: 在PRISM和GlobalOpinionQA数据集上，少数群体奖励模型性能提升达7点，数据效率提高280%，并减轻了过度偏见。
AI.conclusion: SCPO有效且高效，能够平衡多元文化偏好，减少偏见。

title: Dango: A Strictly L1-Only Large Language Model for Studying Second Language Acquisition
comment: 8 pages main text, 20 pages total including references and appendices
summary: We introduce Dango, a 1.8B-parameter large language model designed for controlled studies of L1-to-L2 (Japanese-to-English) transfer in second language acquisition (SLA). While previous studies have explored SLA in language models, they have predominantly relied on smaller or non-decoder models, limiting their ability to generate open-ended text and reducing their suitability as practical L2 simulators. We identify a key challenge when scaling models to this size: L2 contamination within the "monolingual" pretraining corpus used for L1 acquisition. To address this, we propose a filtering method to reduce premature exposure to English while preserving realistic, minimal exposure. We then fine-tune the model on LLM-generated L2-learning lessons to simulate the L2 acquisition process. Our evaluations confirm that Dango develops human-like L2 production patterns, outperforming both unfiltered and standard multilingual baselines. We release the model, data, and code to facilitate reproducible computational SLA research and learner-facing applications.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个1.8B参数的LLM Dango，通过过滤L2污染和微调来模拟第二语言习得。
AI.motivation: 之前的研究使用较小或非解码器模型，限制了生成开放式文本的能力，不适合作为L2模拟器；且存在L2污染问题。
AI.method: 提出过滤方法减少L2污染，然后在LLM生成的L2学习课程上微调模型。
AI.result: Dango产生类似人类的L2生产模式，优于未过滤和标准多语言基线。
AI.conclusion: 发布模型、数据和代码以促进可重复的计算SLA研究和面向学习者的应用。

title: DreamReasoner-8B: Block-Size Curriculum Learning for Diffusion Reasoning Models
summary: Block diffusion language models accelerate decoding through parallel block-wise denoising, yet whether they can be reliably scaled for long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning remains unresolved. To this end, we develop DreamReasoner-8B, an open-source block diffusion reasoning model, and conduct a systematic study of how training and inference block sizes affect long-CoT reasoning. Our analysis reveals a stark performance disparity: training with large block sizes yields remarkably poor reasoning, whereas small block sizes preserve effective reasoning. To bridge this granularity gap, we propose block-size curriculum learning, which gradually transitions training from fine-grained to coarse-grained block sizes, thereby overcoming this limitation and enabling strong reasoning performance that generalizes across diverse inference block sizes. On mathematical and code reasoning benchmarks, DreamReasoner-8B achieves results competitive with leading open autoregressive models such as Qwen3-8B. This work establishes a practical foundation for efficient, reasoning-capable diffusion language models. We release our model at .

AI.tldr: 提出DreamReasoner-8B，采用块大小课程学习，实现高效的块扩散长链推理，性能与领先的自回归模型相当。
AI.motivation: 块扩散语言模型通过并行块去噪加速解码，但其在长链推理中的可扩展性尚未明确。
AI.method: 提出块大小课程学习，训练时从细粒度逐渐过渡到粗粒度的块大小，以弥合训练与推理块大小的粒度差距。
AI.result: 在数学和代码推理基准上，DreamReasoner-8B取得了与Qwen3-8B等领先开源自回归模型竞争的性能。
AI.conclusion: 为高效、推理能力的扩散语言模型建立了实践基础，并开源了模型。

title: Montreal Forced Aligner and the state of speech-to-text alignment in 2026
summary: The Montreal Forced Aligner (MFA) was released in 2016 and has since become the most widely used tool for forced alignment in research and industry. In the decade since, MFA has undergone substantial development, including expanded coverage across more languages and dialects using larger open-source datasets, harmonized IPA dictionaries, model adaptation, cross-language phone remapping, and support utilities. This paper documents MFA 3.0's developments since version 1.0 and evaluates MFA's performance across English, Japanese, and Korean, benchmarked against classic and neural forced aligners. MFA 3.0 achieves state-of-the-art or near state-of-the-art performance across all four benchmark datasets with mean boundary errors below 15 ms. Adaptation and cross-language remapping are effective for languages outside MFA's training distribution, and pronunciation probability modeling and phonological rules provide gains in specific conditions.

AI.tldr: MFA 3.0通过扩展覆盖和模型改进，在多个语言上实现了接近或超越现有技术的强制对齐性能，平均边界误差低于15毫秒。
AI.motivation: MFA已成为最广泛使用的强制对齐工具，但自1.0版本以来经历了重大发展，需要系统记录其进展并评估其最新性能。
AI.method: 文档化了MFA 3.0的发展，并在英语、日语和韩语的四个基准数据集上将其与经典和神经强制对齐器进行性能对比。
AI.result: MFA 3.0在所有数据集上达到或接近最先进水平，平均边界误差低于15毫秒；适应和跨语言重映射对训练分布外的语言有效，发音概率建模和音系规则在特定条件下带来提升。
AI.conclusion: MFA 3.0表现优异，适应和跨语言重映射方法有效，发音概率建模和音系规则可在特定条件下提供额外增益。

title: Beyond Scalar Scores: Exploring LLM-based Metrics for Clinical Significance Evaluation in Radiology Reports
summary: Reliable evaluation of generated radiology reports requires strict clinical accuracy, as omitted critical findings or mischaracterized radiographic observations can directly affect patient care. Existing metrics obscure this requirement by reducing report quality to a medically ungrounded scalar. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) possess rich medical knowledge, they likewise struggle to draw a reliable boundary between clinically significant errors and harmless variation. We study this boundary using ReEvalMed benchmark as testbed and evaluate metric-level clinical significance from detecting true clinical errors ("Discrimination") and tolerating insignificant variations ("Robustness"). Across 8 LLM evaluators under one-pass and two-pass settings, we identify a widespread discrimination bias: models effectively detect errors but also over-penalize harmless rephrasings. To mitigate this, we synthesize 4k report pairs and train lightweight interpretable metrics on Qwen3-8B and MedGemma-4B. Our trained metric sharpens the clinical significance boundary, surpassing 32B-scale medical LLMs and remaining competitive with proprietary models. Crucially, the more costly two-pass setting fails to consistently improve overall performance and mainly trades discrimination for robustness. These findings suggest one-pass trained metrics as the practical choice for cost-sensitive deployment, with two-pass inference reserved for settings where D-R balance is critical. We will release the dataset and metric.

AI.tldr: 提出ReEvalMed基准和轻量级可解释指标，通过训练Qwen3-8B和MedGemma-4B模型，在临床误差检测上超越大模型，并建议单遍设置用于成本敏感部署。
AI.motivation: 现有评估指标忽略临床准确性，LLM无法可靠区分临床错误和无害变化。
AI.method: 利用ReEvalMed基准，合成4k报告对，在Qwen3-8B和MedGemma-4B上训练轻量级可解释指标。
AI.result: 训练的指标在辨别和鲁棒性上超越32B级医疗LLM，与专有模型竞争力相当；两遍设置未一致提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 单遍训练指标是成本敏感部署的实用选择，两遍推理保留用于需平衡D-R的场景。

title: Aligning Implied Statements for Implicit Hate Speech Generalizability with Context-Bounded Semi-hard Negative Mining
summary: Classifying implicit hate speech remains a challenge, as intent is often masked through insinuation and context rather than explicit slurs. Prior supervised contrastive approaches improve in-domain detection but can overfit surface cues and struggle to transfer across datasets. We propose ImpSH, a triplet-based framework that aligns posts with implied statements when available and uses context-bounded semi-hard negatives to focus learning on near confusions. We also examine AugSH, which forms positives via data augmentation. In controlled evaluations on IHC, SBIC, and DynaHate with BERT and HateBERT, ImpSH is a viable alternative to standard supervised contrastive baselines and often improves cross-domain performance under matched preprocessing and tuning budgets. Representation analysis using alignment and uniformity indicates tighter positive pairs with balanced global spread, and qualitative nearest-neighbor case studies illustrate typical false negatives under domain shift. These results demonstrate that aligning posts with their implied statements via context-bounded mining provides a more stable, bijective-like mapping to related insinuations, overcoming the volatility inherent in traditional clustering-based representation learning.

AI.tldr: 提出 ImpSH，一种通过将帖子与隐含声明对齐并利用上下文有界半硬负例进行对比学习的框架，用于隐式仇恨言论检测，改善跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 隐式仇恨言论分类因意图常被暗示和语境掩盖而具有挑战性；现有监督对比方法过拟合表面线索且难以跨数据集迁移。
AI.method: 提出 ImpSH（三元组框架，对齐帖子与隐含声明，使用上下文有界半硬负例）和 AugSH（数据增强形成正例），在 BERT 和 HateBERT 上对 IHC、SBIC 和 DynaHate 进行受控评估。
AI.result: ImpSH 是标准监督对比基线 viable 的替代方案，通常提升跨域性能；表示分析显示更紧的正对和均匀全局分布，案例研究揭示域偏移下的典型假负例。
AI.conclusion: 通过上下文有界挖掘将帖子与隐含声明对齐，能提供更稳定的双射式映射到相关暗示，克服传统聚类表示学习的波动性。

title: Beyond Tokenization: Direct Timestep Embedding and Contrastive Alignment for Time-Series Question Answering
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have given rise to time-series question answering (TSQA), which formulates time-series analysis as natural-language question answering. However, directly feeding raw numerical series into LLMs suffers from a tokenization bottleneck: Byte Pair Encoding fragments continuous values into unstable tokens whose embeddings lack meaningful metric structure, resulting in the loss of magnitude, scale, and trend information. Prior methods use patch-based encoders that split the series into fixed windows, locking in one granularity that breaks patterns and hides exact timesteps, through a separate module that rarely transfers across datasets with different lengths or sampling rates. To address this challenge, we propose CADE (Contrastive Alignment with Direct Embedding), a novel framework for TSQA built upon two key components: direct timestep embedding and semantic alignment. The proposed framework maps each timestep directly into the LLM embedding space through a point-wise linear encoder and MLP projector, preserving exact index-level access while eliminating the need for patching and padding. To further bridge the semantic gap between time-series and language representations, we introduce a novel one-directional supervised contrastive loss that aligns time-series embeddings with frozen class-name text anchors. Experimental results on the public Time-MQA benchmark demonstrate that our framework consistently improves performance across six TSQA tasks, outperforming both open-source and proprietary LLM baselines.

AI.tldr: CADE框架通过直接时间步嵌入和语义对齐，解决了LLM在时间序列问答中的标记化瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有方法使用基于块的编码器导致粒度固定和跨数据集迁移问题，且直接喂入数值序列会因标记化损失信息。
AI.method: 提出CADE框架，包含直接时间步嵌入（点式线性编码器和MLP投影器）和单向监督对比损失，对齐时间序列与语言表示。
AI.result: 在Time-MQA基准上，CADE在六个TSQA任务中一致提升性能，优于开源和专有LLM基线。
AI.conclusion: CADE通过直接时间步嵌入和语义对齐有效提升了TSQA性能。

title: RECOM: A Validity Discrimination Tradeoff in Automatic Metrics for Open Ended Reddit Question Answering
summary: Automatic metrics are the default for evaluating LLM-generated text, yet a metric is quietly asked to do two jobs: tell genuine content alignment from surface coincidence (validity), and tell a better system from a worse one (discriminative power). On open-ended, opinion-driven question answering, the two are in tension. We introduce RECOM (Reddit Evaluation for Correspondence of Models), a contamination-free evaluation dataset of 15,000 r/AskReddit questions (September 2025), each paired with its authentic community replies, which postdate every evaluated model's training cutoff. Scoring five open-source LLMs (7--10B) against every reply each metric paired with a random-derangement noise floor we find that no metric does both jobs well. Cosine similarity separates real from random answers (Cohen's $d \approx 2$) but cannot rank the five models ($|d| < 0.1$); BERTScore precision appears to rank the models (raw $|d|$ up to 0.63), but once response length is controlled this collapses to $|d| = 0.09$ and its validity is weak ($d \approx 0.8$, versus cosine's $\approx 2$). Because every metric scores the same outputs, this validity--discrimination tradeoff is a property of the metrics, not the models, and we argue it stems from representation design. Three independent LLM judges reproduce the validity gap and likewise separate the five models only weakly. We recommend reporting metrics on both axes, with an explicit random-baseline floor. RECOM is publicly available at

AI.tldr: 自动指标在评估LLM生成文本时面临有效性和区分力的权衡，引入RECOM数据集后发现没有指标能同时做好，建议报告两个轴并包含随机基线。
AI.motivation: 自动指标被默认使用，但需要同时完成两件事：区分真实内容对齐与表面巧合（有效性），以及区分更好或更差的系统（区分力）。在开放型、观点驱动的问答中，两者存在冲突。
AI.method: 构建RECOM数据集，包含15,000个2025年9月的r/AskReddit问题和真实社区回复，所有回复均晚于评估模型的训练截止日期。使用五个开源LLM（7-10B）生成答案，将每个答案与每个回复配对，采用余弦相似度、BERTScore等指标，并引入随机排列噪声基线，控制响应长度等因素。
AI.result: 余弦相似度能有效区分真假答案（Cohen's d≈2），但无法排名模型（|d|<0.1）；BERTScore精度在未控制长度时能排名模型（|d| up to 0.63），但控制长度后区分力消失（|d|=0.09），且有效性较弱（d≈0.8，对比余弦的≈2）。三个独立LLM法官也重现了有效性差距，但仅能弱分离模型。
AI.conclusion: 没有指标能同时兼顾有效性和区分力，建议在两条轴上报告指标，并包含明确的随机基线。RECOM数据集已公开。

title: DeFAb: A Verifiable Benchmark for Defeasible Abduction in Foundation Models
comment: 33 pages, 14 figures, 23 tables. Dataset: this https URL ; code and evaluation harness: this https URL
summary: A rule-based logic solver resolves every instance in our benchmark in under 50 microseconds with 100% accuracy; the best frontier language model reaches 65% at best and drops to 23.5% under rendering-robust evaluation (worst case over four surface renderings). We introduce DeFAb (Defeasible Abduction Benchmark), a dataset and generation pipeline that converts four decades of publicly funded knowledge bases into formally grounded instances for defeasible abduction: constructing hypotheses that explain anomalies by overriding defaults while preserving unrelated expectations. Because every hypothesis must pass polynomial-time checks for valid derivation, conservativity, and minimality, DeFAb makes logical rigor the instrument for measuring creativity and theoretical reasoning, scoring the disciplined construction of theory revisions rather than fluent but theory-destroying prose. The pipeline pairs taxonomic hierarchies (OpenCyc, YAGO, Wikidata) with behavioral property graphs (ConceptNet, UMLS) to produce 372,648+ instances across 33.75M materialized rules from 18 sources, in three levels with polynomial-time verifiable gold standards. Four frontier models do not reliably internalize defeasible reasoning: rendering-robust Level 2 accuracy is 7.8-23.5%; chain-of-thought variance (~36 pp) exceeds any inter-model gap; and a matched contamination control isolates a +19.4 pp Level 3 gap. We further release DeFAb-Hard (a 235-instance Level 3 difficulty variant; best model 53.3% vs 100% symbolic) and CONJURE (a kernel-verified transformative-creativity variant of 560 Lean 4/Mathlib instances whose gold answers are definitions the proof kernel did not previously contain, judge-free verifier; a pilot finds zero novel concepts). The same verifier doubles as an exact reward for preference optimization (DPO, RLVR/GRPO). Released under MIT at .

AI.tldr: DeFAb is a benchmark and generation pipeline for defeasible abduction, testing logical rigor with verifiable hypotheses; frontier models perform poorly, especially under rendering-robust evaluation.
AI.motivation: Current language models lack rigorous defeasible reasoning; existing benchmarks fail to enforce logical consistency. DeFAb uses publicly funded knowledge bases to formally ground instances.
AI.method: Pipeline combining taxonomic hierarchies (OpenCyc, YAGO, Wikidata) with behavioral property graphs (ConceptNet, UMLS) to generate 372,648+ instances across 33.75M materialized rules from 18 sources, with polynomial-time verifiable gold standards.
AI.result: Symbolic solver achieves 100% accuracy in <50μs; best frontier model 65% dropping to 23.5% under robust evaluation. Chain-of-thought variance exceeds inter-model gaps. Contamination control shows +19.4 pp gap on Level 3.
AI.conclusion: Defeasible reasoning is not reliably internalized by frontier models. DeFAb provides a rigorous instrument for measuring creativity and theory revision, and the verifier can serve as reward for preference optimization.

title: Freeing the Law with LOCUS: A Local Ordinance Corpus for the United States
summary: Progress in legal AI increasingly depends on access to authoritative legal text at scale. Yet one of the most consequential layers of American law remains largely absent from existing machine-readable corpora: local ordinances. Local codes govern zoning, housing, business licensing, public health, noise, animal control, and many other domains of everyday regulation, but they are fragmented across vendor platforms designed for human browsing rather than bulk research access. We introduce LOCUS - the Local Ordinance Corpus for the United States - a comprehensive corpus and county-harmonized access layer for U.S. municipal and county ordinance codes. The raw corpus, available for release to researchers, represents nearly all publicly available municipal and county ordinance codes. The resulting raw corpus contains codes from 9,239 cities and counties. A smaller county-harmonized LOCUS access layer provides coverage for the largest 2,309 of 3,144 U.S. counties, accounting for a majority of the population. We use OCR to handle the myriad of document formats that have kept the law from being a public resource. We release the corpus with coverage metadata to support reproducibility, downstream legal AI research, and the incremental expansion of machine-readable access to local law. We train a collection of ModernBERT-based classifiers and scorers to facilitate analyzing U.S. local law among several dimensions, such as opacity and paternalism, that have not previously been studied at this scale. LOCUS-v1 and its derivative models are available at:

AI.tldr: 介绍LOCUS，一个包含美国绝大多数地方条例的语料库和县级协调访问层，并训练了基于ModernBERT的分类器用于分析。
AI.motivation: 地方条例对法律AI至关重要，但现有语料库缺乏此类数据，且这些条例分散在不同平台，难以批量获取。
AI.method: 通过OCR处理多种文档格式，收集了9,239个城市和县的公开条例；构建了覆盖2,309个县的协调访问层；并训练了基于ModernBERT的分类器和评分器。
AI.result: 原始语料库包含9,239个城市和县的代码，县级协调层覆盖美国大部分人口，并提供了覆盖元数据以支持可重复性。
AI.conclusion: LOCUS及其衍生模型已发布，旨在促进法律AI研究和地方条例的机器可读访问扩展。

title: Continuous Audio Thinking for Large Audio Language Models
summary: Large audio language models (LALMs) have shown impressive capabilities on diverse audio understanding tasks, ranging from speech transcription to music analysis. However, because LALMs are typically trained to produce text-aligned responses, their hidden states are progressively shaped for text generation rather than for preserving acoustic information. As a result, the diverse acoustic content that audio carries, such as phonetic detail, prosody, sound events, affect, and pitch, is lost along the way and difficult to leverage in the response. We introduce Continuous Audio Thinking (CoAT), a framework that equips audio language models with a continuous latent workspace for organizing acoustic information prior to response generation, grounded by distillation from audio experts. Within the thinking space, the model can utilize the rich acoustic information provided by expert distillation when generating its response. Furthermore, the proposed continuous thinking block can be processed in a single prefill, so CoAT does not require additional autoregressive decoding cost over the baseline. Across three LALMs, Qwen2-Audio, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, and Audio Flamingo~3, performance gains on a broad benchmark suite spanning audio reasoning, audio understanding, music classification, speech emotion, and speech transcription demonstrate the effectiveness of CoAT. Further analysis confirms that the auxiliary supervision propagates from the thinking positions to the model's textual responses.

AI.tldr: 提出CoAT框架，通过连续潜在工作空间和专家蒸馏，在响应生成前组织声学信息，提升音频语言模型性能而不增加解码成本。
AI.motivation: 现有音频语言模型训练目标导致丢失声学信息，无法充分利用音频中的丰富内容。
AI.method: 引入连续音频思考空间，基于音频专家知识蒸馏，在单个预填充中处理，无需额外自回归解码。
AI.result: 在Qwen2-Audio、Qwen2.5-Omni-7B和Audio Flamingo 3三个模型上，音频推理、理解、分类、情感、转录等任务均取得性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CoAT有效辅助监督从思考位置传播到模型的文本响应。

title: LLM Parameters for Math Across Languages: Shared or Separate?
comment: 5 pages. Accepted at ACL Student Research Workshop (SRW) 2026. Code: this https URL Translated Datasets: this https URL Webpage: https://math-across-languages.github.io
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit substantial cross-lingual variation in mathematical reasoning performance, but it remains unclear whether these differences reflect language-specific parameters or a shared mechanism that manifests differently by language. We present a cross-lingual mechanistic analysis of mathematical reasoning in LLMs, enabling us to localize and compare model parameters that support mathematical reasoning across languages. We find that the extracted math-associated parameters exhibit partial cross-lingual overlap, with the strongest overlap concentrated in intermediate model layers. We further observe that English consistently produces the largest set of math-relevant parameters, whereas lower-resource languages reveal smaller sets of relevant parameters. These results suggest that math-related behavior in multilingual LLMs is neither fully language-invariant nor fully language-specific, but instead exhibits partial cross-lingual parameter overlap with systematic language-dependent differences.

AI.tldr: 数学推理在LLM中表现出部分跨语言参数重叠，且英语参数集最大。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM数学推理的跨语言差异是源于语言特定参数还是共享机制。
AI.method: 进行跨语言机制分析，定位和比较支持数学推理的模型参数，提取数学相关参数并比较跨语言重叠。
AI.result: 数学相关参数有部分跨语言重叠，主要集中在中间层；英语参数集最大，低资源语言参数集较小。
AI.conclusion: 数学行为既非完全语言不变也非完全语言特定，而是部分重叠且存在系统性语言依赖差异。

title: Possible or Definite? A Benchmark for Evaluating Diagnostic Uncertainty Preservation in Clinical Text
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for clinical text tasks such as summarization and revision. While most studies evaluate the fluency and coherence of LLM-generated text, whether LLMs correctly preserve diagnostic uncertainty remains underexplored. In clinical practice, phrases such as ``possible pneumonia'' communicate the strength of available evidence and directly guide decisions about follow-up testing and treatment. Altering these uncertainty expressions can change the clinical meaning entirely. In this paper, we systematically evaluated this problem in two steps. First, we constructed a benchmark of 1,200 clinical documents with 9,184 uncertainty annotations across five levels. Second, we evaluated three LLMs on this benchmark. Our results show that (1) LLMs preserve the original uncertainty cues poorly, often less than half the time; (2) LLMs struggle with nuanced distinctions between adjacent levels. This work reveals a failure mode not captured by standard evaluation metrics and provides implications for the safe deployment of LLMs in clinical workflows.

AI.tldr: LLMs在临床文本任务中难以保留诊断不确定性，经常改变不确定性表达，对临床意义有重大影响。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要评估LLMs生成文本的流畅性和连贯性，但忽略了它们是否正确保留了诊断不确定性，而这种不确定性对于临床决策至关重要。
AI.method: 构建包含1,200个临床文档和9,184个不确定性标注（五个级别）的基准，评估三个LLMs在保留不确定性方面的表现。
AI.result: LLMs保留原始不确定性线索的比例不足一半，且难以区分相邻不确定性级别之间的细微差别。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了标准评估指标未捕获的失败模式，为LLMs在临床工作流程中的安全部署提供了重要启示。

title: PreUnlearn: Auditing Collateral Knowledge Damage Before Large Language Model Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) aims to remove specified knowledge while preserving the rest of the model's capabilities. However, the boundary between knowledge to forget and knowledge to retain is often unclear, since related and even distant information may be entangled in the model. In this paper, we study LLM unlearning from a data-centric perspective and measure how unlearning effects propagate from the forget set to same-domain and distant-domain knowledge. We find a consistent decay pattern: collateral damage is strongest near the forget set, weakens with semantic distance, but does not disappear at domain boundaries. We further ask whether such damage can be audited before unlearning is executed. We formulate forget-set auditing as a pre-unlearning prediction task and analyze which data features are most predictive of downstream damage. Our results show that interaction features between the forget set and evaluation set provide the strongest signals, suggesting that collateral damage is partly reflected in data geometry before model updates occur. These findings position forget-set auditing as an early warning tool for identifying risky unlearning runs and designing more reliable unlearning procedures.

AI.tldr: 从数据中心的视角研究LLM遗忘中附带损害的传播模式，发现衰减模式并通过遗忘集审计实现早期预警。
AI.motivation: 遗忘边界不清晰，相关知识甚至遥远信息在模型中纠缠，导致附带损害难以控制。
AI.method: 通过测量遗忘集到同域和远域知识的效应传播，并设计预遗忘预测任务分析数据特征，特别是交互特征。
AI.result: 附带损害随语义距离衰减但不消失，交互特征对下游损害预测力最强。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘集审计可作为早期预警工具，帮助识别风险遗忘运行并设计更可靠遗忘程序。

title: Speech-Driven End-to-End Language Discrimination towards Chinese Dialects
summary: Language discrimination among similar languages, varieties, and dialects is a challenging natural language processing task. The traditional text-driven focus leads to poor results. In this paper, we explore the effectiveness of speech-driven features towards language discrimination among Chinese dialects. First, we systematically explore the appropriateness of speech-driven MFCC features towards CNN-based language discrimination. Then, we design an end-to-end speech recognition model based on HMM-DNN to predict Chinese dialect words. We adopt attention to extract the discriminative words related to different Chinese dialects. Finally, through a CNN, we combine the word-level embedding and the MFCC-based features. Evaluation of two benchmark Chinese dialect corpora shows the appropriateness and effectiveness of the proposed speech-driven approach to fine-grained Chinese dialect discrimination compared to the state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: A speech-driven approach using MFCC features and an HMM-DNN model with attention and CNN achieves state-of-the-art fine-grained Chinese dialect discrimination.
AI.motivation: Traditional text-driven methods perform poorly for language discrimination among similar dialects, necessitating speech-driven features.
AI.method: First, explore speech-driven MFCC features for CNN-based discrimination; then, design an end-to-end HMM-DNN speech recognition model to predict dialect words with attention; finally, combine word embeddings and MFCC features via CNN.
AI.result: Evaluation on two benchmark Chinese dialect corpora demonstrates appropriateness and effectiveness, outperforming state-of-the-art methods.
AI.conclusion: The proposed speech-driven approach is effective and appropriate for fine-grained Chinese dialect discrimination.

title: Low-resource Language Discrimination Towards Chinese Dialects with Transfer learning and Data Augmentation
summary: Chinese dialects discrimination is a challenging natural language processing task due to scarce annotation resource. In this article, we develop a novel Chinese dialects discrimination framework with transfer learning and data augmentation (CDDTLDA) in order to overcome the shortage of resources. To be more specific, we first use a relatively larger Chinese dialects corpus to train a source-side automatic speech recognition (ASR) model. Then, we adopt a simple but effective data augmentation method (i.e., speed, pitch, and noise disturbance) to augment the target-side low-resource Chinese dialects, and fine-tune another target ASR model based on the previous source-side ASR model. Meanwhile, the potential common semantic features between source-side and target-side ASR models can be captured by using self-attention mechanism. Finally, we extract the hidden semantic representation in the target ASR model to conduct Chinese dialects discrimination. Our extensive experimental results demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on two benchmark Chinese dialects corpora.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合迁移学习与数据增强的中文方言识别框架CDDTLDA。
AI.motivation: 中文方言识别因标注资源稀缺而面临挑战。
AI.method: 先在较大方言语料库上训练源ASR模型，再通过速度、音调、噪声扰动增强目标方言数据，基于源模型微调目标ASR模型，并用自注意力机制捕获共同语义特征，最后提取目标模型隐藏表示进行识别。
AI.result: 在两个基准中文方言语料库上显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: CDDTLDA有效解决了低资源中文方言识别问题。

title: Are LLMs Ready to Assist Physicians? PhysAssistBench for Interactive Doctor-Patient-EHR Assistance
summary: The most plausible near-term role of medical LLMs is to assist rather than replace physicians, yet current evaluations often test isolated capabilities: clinical knowledge, EHR system interaction, or patient communication. Physician assistance instead requires coordinating these capabilities within the same interaction, where physicians issue underspecified requests, patients describe symptoms ambiguously, and EHR systems demand precise tool use. We introduce PhysAssistBench, a benchmark for interactive doctor-patient-EHR assistance. Built from real MIMIC-IV cases, PhysAssistBench uses a scalable pipeline to construct agentic patients: interactive, record-grounded agents that turn static EHR records into multi-turn clinical scenarios while preserving clinical factuality. PhysAssistBench provides a curated bilingual evaluation set of 1,296 manually reviewed and physician-validated turns. Experiments with leading LLMs show that current models remain unreliable in this setting, which exposes a key bottleneck for clinical LLMs: reliable assistance requires coordination across knowledge, communication, and systems, not isolated gains in any of them.

AI.tldr: 提出PhysAssistBench基准，评估医学LLM在医生-患者-EHR交互中的协助能力，发现当前模型不可靠，需协调知识、沟通和系统。
AI.motivation: 现有评估测试孤立能力（临床知识、EHR交互、患者沟通），而实际协助需要这些能力的协调。
AI.method: 基于MIMIC-IV构建可交互的agentic患者，将静态记录转为多轮临床场景，创建1,296个双语评估回合。
AI.result: 领先LLM在该基准中表现不可靠，表明当前模型在协调能力上存在瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 可靠协助需要跨知识、沟通和系统的协调，而非孤立提升任一能力。

title: PragReST: Self-Reinforcing Counterfactual Reasoning for Pragmatic Language Understanding
comment: First two authors contributed equally. Code and models: this https URL
summary: Natural language understanding often depends on meanings that are implied rather than explicitly stated, requiring pragmatic reasoning. Despite strong performance on math and logical reasoning, large language models (LLMs) still struggle with making pragmatic inferences, often choosing literal interpretations. To improve LLM pragmatic reasoning, we introduce PragReST, a self-supervised framework that constructs pragmatic QA data, generates counterfactual reasoning traces, and trains models to internalize them through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, without human-labeled training data or distillation from a stronger teacher. Across four pragmatic benchmarks (PragMega, Ludwig, MetoQA, and AltPrag), PragReST improves over backbone models, task-specific pragmatic tuning baselines, and non-counterfactual variants of the same pipeline. On accuracy-based benchmarks, PragReST improves over the instruct backbone by 5.37 and 5.50% (absolute) for Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B, respectively. Our error analysis and ablations underscore the importance of counterfactual reasoning: PragReST primarily reduces errors caused by failures to contrast observed utterances with plausible alternatives, and removing counterfactual reasoning substantially reduces performance. Moreover, our training preserves out-of-domain performance on general-knowledge and mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: PragReST improves LLM pragmatic reasoning via self-supervised counterfactual reasoning without human annotations or distillation.
AI.motivation: LLMs struggle with pragmatic inferences despite strong math/logic performance, often choosing literal interpretations.
AI.method: A self-supervised framework that constructs pragmatic QA data, generates counterfactual reasoning traces, and trains models with SFT and RL.
AI.result: Outperforms baselines on four benchmarks; improves Qwen3-8B/14B by 5.37% and 5.50% absolute accuracy; errors primarily due to lack of counterfactual reasoning.
